text: [MIXED-READINESS FOLLOW-UP to 102-F/106-S — dependency gate satisfied on 2026-07-31: 102-F and 106-S are archived; 102.001-T/102.002-T are done; operator decision remains outstanding] Deferred in-repo Ship claim-integrity hardening: (1) READY FOR FUTURE PLANNING: extend shipment-reconcile pre-mode with a shipment-record-status classification comparing the shipment's own status with manifest-task statuses as the long-term integrity-check home; (2) DECISION-GATED: consider true self-repair (auto re-claim/repair) only after deliberately lifting the skill's current report-and-halt / no-auto-repair stance; (3) LEARNING FOLLOW-UP: capture CLAIM_VERIFY_FAILED, SHIPMENT_STATE_INCONSISTENT, and the queued-with-active-work pattern as a compound learning after operator routing.
